Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026.

This policy covers two different things: (1) this website (https://plenivostudio.pages.dev), and (2) the downloadable planner software. They handle data very differently, so we describe them separately.

1. This website

What we collect

  • Contact messages: if you email us, we receive your name, email address and message content so we can reply. We use it only for that purpose.
  • Payments: when checkout is activated, payment processing is provided by our payment processor as Merchant of Record. They collect and process payment information under their own privacy policy. We do not receive or store your card details.

What we do not collect on this site

  • There is currently no analytics, no advertising tracking and no cookies set by this website. If that changes, this policy will be updated before any tracking begins.

2. The downloadable planner

The planner is an offline HTML file that runs entirely in your browser. It:

  • stores your planning data locally on your device (IndexedDB with a localStorage fallback);
  • makes no network requests — no analytics, no tracking, no cloud sync, no external fonts or scripts;
  • never transmits your data to us or to anyone else. There is no technical mechanism by which we could see it.

Because your data lives in your browser, clearing browser/site data will remove it. The planner includes a manual JSON export so you can keep your own backups — we recommend using it regularly.

Data retention and your rights

  • Contact emails are kept only as long as needed to handle your request.
  • Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct or delete personal data we hold about you. Contact us to exercise them.

Controller

Plenivostudio. Contact: info.cosmicragsltd@gmail.com.

Changes to this policy

If we change this policy, we will update the "last updated" date above. Material changes will be announced on this site before they take effect.
